# Victor Trofin

> Software engineer & product builder (8+ years). I create AI-powered productivity tools that replace tedious manual work with elegant systems — giving teams their time back. This portfolio showcases detailed case studies with measurable business outcomes.

I specialize in full-stack web engineering with strong focus on TypeScript, React/Vue, Node.js, AWS, and building autonomous AI agents (including custom BMAD multi-agent orchestration frameworks used to evolve this site itself).

## Key Projects

- [Calliope AI](https://trofin.me/projects/calliope): AI call center platform with custom guided call panel, state machines, transcription, and sentiment analysis. **Outcome:** Agents handle 3× more calls; managers get time back for coaching.
- [EyeQ](https://trofin.me/projects/eyeq): Automated video interviewing & screening platform with AI transcription and evaluation. **Outcome:** Dramatically reduces recruiter screening time while delivering structured candidate feedback.
- [Bluum Hire (ATS)](https://trofin.me/projects/ats): Modern applicant tracking system replacing spreadsheets for Japan's graduate recruitment cycle. **Outcome:** Single unified pipeline for full campaign visibility.
- [Ship&Co](https://trofin.me/projects/shipandco): Shipping management dashboard with rate comparison and one-click label printing. **Outcome:** Reduced 30-minute manual process to a few clicks.

Full technical deep-dives, screenshots, architecture decisions, and "At a Glance" summaries available on each project page.

## How I Work

1. **Talk** — Jargon-free conversation to understand your real problems.
2. **Plan** — Clear scoped roadmap with your sign-off *before* any code is written.
3. **Build** — Short iterative cycles with visible working software early and often.
4. **Launch** — Ship, verify, and ensure you can run and maintain it independently.

See the full process on the homepage.

## Technical Expertise

- **Languages:** TypeScript (primary), ReScript, JavaScript
- **Frontend:** React, Vue.js, Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn
- **Backend/Infra:** Node.js (Fastify/Hono), AWS (Lambda, Connect, SST, Terraform), PostgreSQL, Prisma
- **AI/Agents:** LLM integration, transcription/sentiment analysis, autonomous agent frameworks (BMAD), agentic development workflows
- **Other:** State machines, real-time systems, reliability (Sentry), CI/CD, performance
